description: Defines SSL client socket class and related context for SSL configuration and session management within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: SSLClientSocket
classes.description: A client socket that uses SSL as the transport layer, handling SSL handshake and connection retries.

classes.name: SSLClientContext
classes.description: Shared state and configuration for multiple SSLClientSockets, including SSL configuration, session cache, and observers.

classes.name: SSLConfigChangeType
classes.description: Enumeration of SSL configuration change types.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Interface for observing SSL configuration changes for all servers or specific server changes.

methods.name: GetECHRetryConfigs
methods.description: Returns serialized ECHConfigList for retrying connection after ECH error.

methods.name: SetSSLKeyLogger
methods.description: Sets the SSL key logger for logging SSL key material.

methods.name: SerializeNextProtos
methods.description: Serializes Next Protocols in ALPN wire format.

methods.name: SSLClientContext
methods.description: Constructor for SSLClientContext with configuration parameters.

methods.name: CreateSSLClientSocket
methods.description: Creates an SSLClientSocket for a given stream socket and configuration.

methods.name: GetClientCertificate
methods.description: Retrieves client certificate preferences for a server.

methods.name: SetClientCertificate
methods.description: Sets client certificate and key for a server.

methods.name: ClearClientCertificate
methods.description: Removes client certificate preference for a server.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for SSL configuration changes.

methods.name: OnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the certificate verifier.

methods.name: OnCertDBChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the certificate database.
